sloka: मम शल्यमनुद्धत्य बान्धवानां महाबल।शत्रुसैन्यं प्रताप्यैकस्त्वं मां सन्त्यज्य गच्छसि ।। ६.६८.११ ।।
transliteration: mama śalyamanuddhatya bāndhavānāṁ mahābala।śatrusainyaṁ pratāpyaikastvaṁ māṁ santyajya gacchasi ।। 6.68.11 ।।

translations.english: "O Kumbhakarna of extraordinary might! You have tormented the enemy army singlehanded with valour. You are going alone leaving me and the kinsfolk."
